negativeFixtureConvention.signature: Simulator controls assume signatureValid. That assumption is simulation-only. A valid real signature does not survive changing signed bytes. Malicious mutated state is not historically reachable.

negativeFixtureConvention.exactPlanNewStatement: ExactPlan extra and reorder controls use a new simulated statement with a signature-valid assumption. They never assert that an unchanged real signature still verifies.
